program_solutions:
(rule!
 ;; Maroon(9) frames each hold a small figure and carry a KEY color
 ;; dot just above their top edge. Extract each figure (maroon
 ;; scrubbed, cropped) and lay them out in one row ordered by key
 ;; color — vertically centered, one blank column between neighbors.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (crop-nonzero grid)
       (let ((cells (filter (lambda (p) (> (at grid (first p)
                                              (second p))
                                           0))
                            (grid-positions grid))))
         (if (empty? cells)
             (list (list 0))
             (let ((bb (bbox-of-cells cells)))
               (subgrid grid (first bb) (second bb)
                        (third bb) (fourth bb))))))
     (define (frame? o)  ;; hollow maroon rectangle outline, 3x3+
       (and (= (obj-color o) 9)
            (>= (obj-h o) 3) (>= (obj-w o) 3)
            (= (obj-size o) (- (* 2 (+ (obj-h o) (obj-w o))) 4))
            (all? (lambda (p) (or (= (first p) (obj-r1 o))
                                  (= (first p) (obj-r2 o))
                                  (= (second p) (obj-c1 o))
                                  (= (second p) (obj-c2 o))))
                  (obj-cells o))))
     (define frames
       (sort (filter frame? (objects g 0))
             (lambda (a b) (or (< (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b))
                               (and (= (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b))
                                    (< (obj-c1 a) (obj-c1 b)))))))
     (define (key-of fr)
       (let ((r (- (obj-r1 fr) 1)))
         (first (if (>= r 0)
                    (filter (lambda (v) (not (member? v (list 0 9))))
                            (map (lambda (c) (at g r c))
                                 (range (obj-c1 fr)
                                        (+ (obj-c2 fr) 1))))
                    (list)))))
     (define (figure-of fr)
       (crop-nonzero
        (cellmap (subgrid g (+ (obj-r1 fr) 1) (+ (obj-c1 fr) 1)
                          (- (obj-r2 fr) 1) (- (obj-c2 fr) 1))
                 (r c v) (if (= v 9) 0 v))))
     (define figures
       (map second
            (sort (map (lambda (fr) (list (key-of fr) (figure-of fr)))
                       frames)
                  (lambda (a b) (< (first a) (first b))))))
     (let ((oh (apply max (map rows figures)))
           (ow (+ (apply + (map cols figures))
                  (- (length figures) 1))))
       (let loop ((xs figures) (left 0) (out (empty-grid oh ow 0)))
         (if (empty? xs)
             out
             (let ((piece (first xs)))
               (loop (rest xs) (+ left (cols piece) 1)
                     (for*/fold ((acc out))
                                ((r (range 0 (rows piece)))
                                 (c (range 0 (cols piece))))
                       (let ((v (at piece r c)))
                         (if (> v 0)
                             (set-cell acc
                                       (+ (quotient (- oh (rows piece))
                                                    2)
                                          r)
                                       (+ left c) v)
                             acc)))))))))))
